div.div: 1 غَافَتِ الشَّجَرَةُ , (S, O, K,) aor. تَغِيفُ, (O, K,) inf. n. غَيَفَانٌ; (S, O, K;) and ↓ تغيّفت , (S, O, K, *) in the copies of the K erroneously تغيّف; (TA;) as also ↓ أَغْيَفَت , inf. n. إِغْيَافٌ; (TA;) The tree inclined, (S,) or had its branches inclining, (O, K,) to the right and left. (S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
